items.title: Software Engineer at Mindgate Solutions
items.intro: Engineer on VTransact, a multi-country tax-payment platform that lets a multinational bank's corporate customers pay taxes and government dues across countries, built with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and Oracle.
items.details:
Backend development for banking and regulatory payment integrations.
- Built VTransact services that integrate with government and regulatory systems in each country, including multiple Nigerian payment channels for tax collection.
- Developed an internal cryptographic digital-signature generator used to sign requests for a Middle East regulatory API integration.
- Built Java/Spring Boot microservices on WebSphere, using Kafka and WebSphere MQ for messaging and Oracle DB/PostgreSQL for persistence.
- Wrote Spring Batch data-migration tools and other internal utilities used day to day by the engineering team.

items.title: Codist
items.intro: A local AI code reviewer for Java/Spring Boot repos. It maps services, classes and Feign calls into a live graph, and reviews every commit with exact code checks, a local LLM whose claims must quote the code, and before/after behaviour runs. Nothing leaves your machine.
